suggestions: I'm grateful for the app staying up all night without a single page, so I actually slept through it.
I'm thankful for my dad still insisting on driving me to the LRT station even though I keep telling him it's fine.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that saved me from shipping something embarrassing to prod.
I'm thankful for the azan drifting in from the mosque down the road while I'm still half-asleep, reminding me the day hasn't really started yet.
I'm grateful for a senior dev who explained the legacy codebase instead of just telling me to go read it myself.
I'm thankful for roti canai still being hot by the time I get it home, even after the Grab rider had three other stops.
I'm grateful for a staging environment catching the bug before any customer ever saw it.
I'm thankful for my little cousin calling just to show off a drawing on video, no reason, no agenda.
I'm grateful for the first sip of teh ais after standing in the office pantry queue for ten minutes.
I'm thankful for a payday that lands clean, no surprise deductions, just quiet rezeki doing its job.
I'm grateful for a Friday standup that actually ends early for once.
I'm thankful for the breeze right before a thunderstorm hits KL, cooling everything down in a way the aircon never does.
I'm grateful for a git merge conflict that resolved itself cleaner than I expected.
I'm thankful for my mother's voice note at 7am just checking if I've eaten, even when she knows I probably haven't.
I'm grateful for an empty inbox on a Sunday night, for once, before the week starts again.
